prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A whimsical, hand-drawn cartoon illustration featuring two anthropomorphic objects as the main subjects: a red and green toothbrush standing upright on the left, and a roll of toilet paper with expressive, narrowed eyes on the right. The toothbrush has a disgruntled expression and a speech bubble that reads, "I hate my job." The toilet paper, looking even more distressed, has a speech bubble that says, "please!!" Both characters are rendered with simple, bold black outlines and minimal shading, giving the scene a playful, comic strip feel. The background is a clean, off-white, allowing the characters to stand out. Below the characters, in large, friendly hand-lettered script, is the phrase: "Always be thankful, Life could be worse." The overall color palette is muted, with the red and green of the toothbrush providing the only pops of color. The style is lighthearted and humorous, with a focus on expressive faces and clear, readable text. The composition is balanced, with the characters and text centrally aligned, and the mood is both comical and gently philosophical.
